notes.title: Official Launch Trailer | Crown and Adventure Will Launch on October 23!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="M7uYrrPPpgw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Greetings, Heroes![/p][p][/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that our open-world strategy RPG Crown and Adventure will officially launch on Steam with a 10% launch discount on [b][i]October 23, 2025![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Overwhelmingly positive demo, now we have a full version launch![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone’s love and support, Crown and Adventure earned overwhelmingly positive reviews during the demo phase, achieving a 96% rating on Steam! We've fully optimized and expanded the official release based on player feedback. Let’s see what we got![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Four Major Upgrades[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Move Vast And Seamless Open World[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/c80f7d245e0072567538e980607b197bc6b91c70.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The official launch version will show a complete continent of Eulogize – a fantasy world shaped by four major factions: Ancient Eastern style: Chen-Yuan, Middle Ages style: Caucaid, Desert-cultured style: Sasin, and mysterious Demonspawn.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/688e50d5218f68e02039039cbf609072077060dd.png"][/img][/p][p]Featuring seamless sandbox design, the launch version will open up to 17 distinct regions for everyone, each with unique cultures and a rich storyline. Additionally, we've added a new starting storyline of Caucaid; you can choose which you want![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Deeper Faction Management Gameplay[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Now the game has combined city management and faction development. Players can boost territory stats through resource management and construction upgrades. Expand your influence via domestic policies, granting territories, and driving reforms to achieve unification.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/6a1e659f819c9ba51f2ed8fdfc68656e01545173.png"][/img][/p][p]Based on the demo’s gameplays such as exploration, combat, and trading, the launch version continues to develop family Position, national governance, and tech tree for more strategic experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Excellent Battlefield for Thousand-Units Combat[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/eb07aebcd52612650c062fa38e02694ec16e7742.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Crown and Adventure use a classical top-down view, supporting massive battles with thousands on-screen. Command diverse heroes and squads for ambushes and sieges in real-time.[/p][p][/p][p]In the launch version, we added new battlefield environments such as lava, corrosive land, deserts, wastelands, and more! Players can form a more powerful legion, recruit more new heroes, and face more challenging crises![/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Recruitable Character![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/57aefd9710be332bc3020015739fc9834a195a2a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There will be over 50 unique heroes in the launch version, each featuring distinct behaviors and AI systems that dynamically react to world events and player choices.[/p][p][/p][p]Recruit these Heroes, improve your relationship, and combine nearly 100 types of soldiers to create your ultimate legion.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, welcome to follow our social channels and wishlist Crown and Adventure! Embark on your fantasy journey at the first moment![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support and love. Have a good game! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/d1f2329a5e8d283ff37de196a6257a1761b59465.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: BECOME IMMORTAL BEINGS! LATEST CHEN-YUAN FACTION CONTENT REVEAL! DEV NOTE
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="uBDxGbFPOSY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Crown and Adventure is a fantasy open-world strategy RPG. Players will become heroes in this world, recruiting companions, forming Legions, and establishing a nation. Explore and conquer the mythical continent “Eulogize”![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Latest Content Reveal: Chen-Yuan Faction showcase[/b][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/6d0c2c3d7774e55bffc216702914b14d025f6c22.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You might have an impressive memory of Chen-Yuan, right? But the Story will keep going! In the short future launch version, the Chen-Yuan area will open a full map with 5 areas: “Zhao-Yang”, “Capital Region”, “Ding-Xi”, “Bei-Ting”, and “Luan”. Along the way, you'll meet new Heroes and recruit many new Chen-Yuan style soldiers!.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/a986f2445fb53b3c9905cddc7d5e9cdd6be72a78.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Ki Masters: Unique Ascender Heroes[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]There are all kinds of ways to use Mana: Caucaid Mages channel it from the outside world, while Chen-Yuan Ascenders turn it inward, transforming it into Ki. With years of training, Ascenders can wield Ki to control lightning, fire, and more—unlocking powers far beyond ordinary mortals. Yun Ziliu and Ni Fanchen are Ascender Heroes you'll meet in the future version.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/f48b3dbaa0f03a2c9c27f651ca03deaaf3bc7065.png"][/img][/p][p]Yun Ziliu is a cool young lady, a sword master who can cut through enemy lines like a blade.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/fdef0a4cefa1e7d0c084fca92f4fb9d1d9a04f36.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Ni Fanchen is a gifted Ascender with loong blood in his veins. He practices the art of loong transformation and can unleash the true power of loong to wipe out his enemies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/4ce731d6a07e12aebb0ef749abb974fc75cb07e9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Divineland: A Beautiful and Mysterious Land[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]With lush mountains and rivers, winding waterways, diverse landscapes, and four distinct seasons, Chen-Yuan is also called the "Divineland"—a blessed land. Start from Zhao-Yang and travel all the way to Luan. You'll experience Chen-Yuan 's stunning scenery and vibrant cultures.[/p][p][/p][p]Zhao-Yan and the Capital Region are fertile and prosperous, bustling with people and merchants—the most lively areas in Chen-Yuan.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/6f9af9396ca3d8079fd7df855f55a8027b49c1d3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Ding-Xi sits in the heart of the desert border, right next to the Sasin Dynasty, where yellow sands stretch as far as you can see.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/fa65bbe39923326429d0efcb5fffaaac2c837c1c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Bei-Ting and Luan are cold, harsh lands, battered by endless snow and wind, with many border fortresses built to fend off invasions from the northern Demonspawn.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/9755f2119993aa3a714bdb731226da48d1f48c3d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Empire's Iron Army: Disciplined and Powerful Elites[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Chen-Yuan boasts a disciplined and mighty army. Ascenders use their mastery of Ki to create special Ascender troops that unleash Ki spells on their enemies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/743cfde82ad1085d82072a64f01aec9ae3e7f320.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Craftsmen sculpt jade and other materials into lifelike stone beasts, which Ascenders then bring to life as beasts that move freely. On the battlefield, these creatures charge fearlessly, pounce on enemies, and can even cast Ki spells just like Ascenders.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/bad0b728d63a88e4be03b642305f1ef2f51d5492.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For Ascenders, Ki gives stone beasts life and becomes a powerful weapon for breaking enemy lines. The Chen-Yuan Empire has a special Tian-Shi troop that controls the celestial thunder. Beyond the imperial army, the vast lands of Chen-Yuan are home to many sect disciples, all skilled in spellcasting.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/1e722c4cbeec0461db1ca568be9d951894f79d97.png"][/img][/p][p]Besides exploring the power of Ki, the Chen-Yuan Empire was also a big player in the development of the War Machine. One of their war machines, the "Artificial Dragon Breathe", can launch blazing fire to scorch enemy troops.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/3af3d8be71af3069e4ee96427d742f7c95a7ae9f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Even without spells or machines, countless soldiers rely on their honed martial skills, making them an indispensable part of the Chen-Yuan Empire's military might. In addition to the Praetorian Guard, which protects the emperor, Chen-Yuan also fields the Qian-Ting Battalion, Pan-Shi Battalion, garrison troops, and other elite units, all working together to keep Chen-Yuan safe and stable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/37910d05ea5d01cf735327259e955547e0ddc5ee.png"][/img][/p][p]With the empire's overwhelming strength, ordinary people might enjoy peace for a lifetime. But with threats both inside and out, the emperor and ministers might not be able to rest easy. The world is like a chessboard, and now the tangled board of Chen-Yuan is waiting for a game-changing move... Who will step up and shake the world?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/cf45776db387e22ba0b9873202a75e19ac36913b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: THE WORLD VIEW OF "CROWN AND ADVENTURE" CHAPTER 4
notes.notes: [p]First of all, I have to say that most of what follows is hearsay, supplemented by some rather subjective records from the Sasin Library. Only my own experiences trading with the Soultrade Merchants in my youth can be considered firsthand. Even so, I am still one of the most knowledgeable people about Demonspawn on the Outer Circle. Now, I will reveal the secret shrouding the center of Eulogize... the reason behind it.[/p][p]——Ashde Fayar[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Our Inferno, Their Dew[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In the final battle of the Collapsed Era, King Kurulek and the God of Tears sacrificed themselves to achieve a temporary victory. The raging lava gradually receded, and the evil god fell into eternal slumber. But the once blessed land ultimately slipped from Mankinds' control. Lava flows, fissures, toxic pools, and ruins turned our former homeland into an uninhabitable wasteland—but that was only true for us. After the war, the Demonspawn quietly emerged from the mantle and claimed the world's center. From then on, it was named the Circle of Calamity. The cradle of all life has now become the origin of all disasters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/f9739e3cb19de1d6ece32d12418f9c5bd70c4343.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Lava, Bones, and Shadows[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The First Lava Disaster shattered the Ancient Empire and awakened fear among the nations of the outer ring. People finally recalled this nearly forgotten land and the ancient enemies who made it their lair. Scholars discovered that Demonspawn were not the mindless, giant, savage beasts of ancient story. They are intelligent races with simple but efficient organizational structures, and a military system no weaker than the outer nations. The threat of the Lava Disaster prompted the outer nations to sign the mutual defense treaty to face the resurgent enemy together. Mankind and Demonspawn, like two gladiators meeting by chance. They circled each other and searched for weaknesses. War is always the primary driver for two races to truly understand each other.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/21d0562d6e76e5d78697a9e11beb5dbb31f2c3a5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After migrating to the Circle of Calamity, the Demonspawn split into three distinct groups. The Blazespawn occupy the eastern plains, where the crust is most torn, building settlements near volcanic lakes and fissures. Blazespawn are tall, with thick, twisted horns and skin ranging in shades of red. As they grow up, their upper bodies will become an obsidian-like keratin layer, forming a natural armor. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/857360af824f5b7b6cd2e0530bfc9b8a456ef7bc.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]Blazespawn most closely match the outer ring's image of Demonspawn: barbaric, fierce, irritable, strong, and nearly impossible to communicate with, forming warbands that roam the wastelands—war is their very reason for existence. The fully armed Blazespawn legion and their beasts form the core of the Demonspawn army. They call themselves the race of war, and indeed they are. In every conflict between Demonspawn and the outer nations, Blazespawn have never been absent.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/5dd2a8378a6a90577e90715a9640cfe4e69e73ef.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Violent geological changes have filled the southern Circle of Calamity with countless fissures and pits. In the Bottomless Pits created by land collapse, Grimspawn built towering spires, forming giant settlements centered on these spires. Beneath the deep pits lie remnants of the Ancient Empire's magical veins, from which Grimspawn draw abundant and pure Mana, zealously studying magic like the King's Servant did. Grimspawn are thin, with pale skin through which veins are visible. Their twisted horns grow from the back of the head, extending forward chaotically, and as they age and power, their horns gradually crystallize. [/p][p][/p][p]Grimspawn follow a harsh, cruel survival law—their society is a massive spire: climb over others or be trampled underfoot. Mages with personal spires rule over those without; those who fail to become Mages will be slaves, expendable resources, or Mana vessels, enduring short and miserable lives. Grimspawn dislikes crude, inefficient warfare, but will not hesitate to use it for their ends. The northern snows of Chen-Yuan and the eternal night of Caucaid Orost are both results of Grimspawn's forbidden Magic.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/8adebdb98e6ea429da14928dd2613aa08fd5d28a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]On the western side of the Circle of Calamity, ruins of Ancient Empire Cities destroyed by lava are everywhere, now home to the Spitespawn. Spitespawn dig caves and build shacks among the city ruins, creating maze-like underground cities. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/47520f8319ea6c6ed0ef4402f916dad5039b2419.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Spitespawn are the closest to Mankinds: fair-skinned, well-proportioned, with soft, skin-covered horns on their foreheads. Some individuals' skin turns grayish-white or pale purple with age, while others do not change. If they hide their horns and tails, or simply cut them off, Spitespawn are nearly indistinguishable from Mankinds and can easily blend into the outer nations. They are also the easiest Demonspawn to communicate with, understanding that intrigue and trade are more efficient than violence. Spitespawn have never launched a large-scale invasion of the outer world; scattered murders, thefts, infiltration, and fraud are trivial by comparison. [/p][p][/p][p]Through the Soultrade Merchants, Spitespawn have established channels of exchange with the outer world, enriching some daring merchants and ruining many more. But don't mistake them for another kind of elf—Spitespawn know nothing of good or mercy toward the worthless. The Molten City always needs sacrifices, the Black Peaks always need materials, and the Abandoned Ruin always needs slaves—whatever the outcome, it will be the most tragic fate you can imagine.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/bbf854bac787785f0dd0455570d1627ff7207f67.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Beyond the three main groups, there is a special class: those corrupted too long by contact with Outer Deity, whose bodies and minds have undergone severe mutation. They belong to no group, skulking like rats in the corners of the Circle of Calamity. All Demonspawn despise some, the three main groups revere others; all are taboo, shrouded in mystery. The true role they play in the Circle of Calamity remains a puzzle to outsiders.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/e0b781b35f1bcacd3c0618bdc94a64ad3d3f0697.jpg"][/img][/p][p]On a side note, the people of the outer ring always debate whether Demonspawn have tails. They have tails, but unlike tailed animals, they don't need them for balance. For them, tails are a burden, likely because their fruit fell into The End prematurely and never fully developed. For convenience in donning armor, Blazespawn Warriors cut off their tails in youth; for concealment, Spitespawn do the same. As for Grimspawn, they cut off their slaves' tails just to save a little food. In short, any Demonspawn you see with a tail is either a pampered noble or old enough to predate the custom.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Obsidian Day[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]According to my young Demonspawn... uh, “partner”, during the first Lava Disaster, Demonspawn were still slaves driven by the Outer Deity's minions, lacking self-will or racial consciousness. Maybe he made this up for business, but Sasin and Holy Elves' Ancient Scripture confirm that after the First Lava Disaster, a brief but fierce civil war broke out within the Circle of Calamity. The Seven Blades, the mysterious Organization controlling the Spitespawn, persuaded the Blazespawn Warlord and Grimspawn Spire Lord to slaughter all loyal apostles of the Outer Deity, removing the Demonspawn's shackles. The three liberating lords became kings of the three groups: the Molten Abyss Overlord Astarnos, Lord of the Peaks Ulista, and the mysterious mistress of the Seven Blades hidden in shadow. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/eb5ab6ffe6e35aab88afee7821cab59dd513c943.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With the apostles' demise and the three groups' independence, Demonspawn's invasions became less urgent, but their interest in the Outer Circle's riches never waned. For centuries, lava tides continued to batter the outer nations' passes, never ceasing.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Lava Disaster[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Shortly after Obsidian Day, the Second Lava Disaster struck the northern border of the Huan Dynasty. On Lord of the Peaks Ulista's order, Grimspawn unleashed a massive blizzard to breach Cheng-Yuan Fort, sending their army south in a poisonous sweep. Except for Li-Loong City, all of Bei-Ting fell, and even northwest Luan was plundered. This event, also called the Northern Disaster, is considered a national humiliation by the Divinelander. The invading Demonspawn were eventually driven back to the Circle of Calamity by the Huan Dynasty, but the spells they cast still affect Bei-Ting to this day: frozen earth, years of snow, and endless anomalies echoing that calamity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/6d2c237165a4d8861c8d198d9ec64552611103dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Decades later, under the Molten Abyss Overlord Astarnos, the Blazespawn assembled a vast legion and invaded the fertile southwestern valleys of the Sagar Kingdom, triggering the Third Lava Disaster. This was the largest and bloodiest invasion yet: the Moltenblood Legion gathered all Blazespawn warbands, and Sagar conscripted nearly every able youth. Both sides fought over every pass and settlement, and countless lives perished in war. [/p][p][/p][p]Due to Sagar's geography and diplomatic isolation, no reinforcements arrived except the Holy Elves. Fighting Demonspawn alone was a fool's errand. The Moltenblood Legion prevailed, seizing the valley. In despair, the leader of the Silence cult prayed to the god of death, and the thousands of deaths moved the Silence to erase all life from the valley. The once-beautiful land became a dead zone, impassable to both Mankinds and Demonspawn. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/c69e89ea4012f5f92a26dc940635dc7848b4fc53.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Third Lava Disaster, known as the Withered Mountain Tragedy, left both sides devastated, with no winner. Afterward, the Sagar Kingdom angrily withdrew from the mutual defense treaty, severing all ties with other nations, rendering the pact meaningless.[/p][p][/p][p]Perhaps the losses of the Withered Mountain Tragedy were too great; Demonspawn retreated to the Circle of Calamity to lick their wounds, not resurfacing until over a century later, when war erupted again at Orost, the Caucaid border fortress. The lords prepared thoroughly: the ruthless Demonspawn wove a forbidden spell of eternal night over the border, causing all outsiders to lose their way, while the Moltenblood Legion, guided by Spire Mages, besieged the isolated Orost. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/99859f8581bf24415e5485f67c9622f821793ea8.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]Unexpectedly, Orost held out for three months with the help of a vanguard of the Rising Paladins. When the Holy Elves finally tore through the darkness and reached the city, the battered fortress still stood. As long-lost light shone on Orost's ruins, a lone Paladin crossed the line of dawn and dusk to charge the chaotic Demonspawn—this is the Caucaidian's famed "Morning of Orost." The Lady of the Rising performed a miracle, her wrath following the Paladin's steed, burning all Demonspawn in their path. [/p][p][/p][p]The Fourth Lava Disaster ended abruptly. Demonspawn had prepared the most, yet suffered the worst defeat. After this, Demonspawn raids on the outer world nearly ceased, and the lords gathered in the hall of World's Abyss to discuss the Demonspawn's future.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Before the Descent[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The failure of the Fourth Lava Disaster plunged the Circle of Calamity into silence. Two consecutive invasions destroyed by miracles made the kings realize their limitations—without power to rival the Deity, Demonspawn could never leave the Circle of Calamity. The three kings withdrew, handing power to their subordinates, and each seeking the boundary between mortals and Deity. To acquire divine power, the once-reviled Outer Deity minions were accepted by the three groups, spreading their twisted teachings and power across the wasteland. A religious Organization called the Cult of Violet Eye spread rapidly among Demonspawn, reminiscent of the old apostle council.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/7fd1a51f4975703fff7b9366084bad17a91d6c92.png"][/img][/p][p]All Demonspawn revere their father god, The Seething, youngest of the gods, the god of war and courage twisted by the Outer Deity. During his captivity, the bond between The Seething and Demonspawn surpassed that of god and Believer; gratitude and reverence for The Seething are passed down in every Demonspawn generation. Perhaps due to their nature, Spitespawn also worship The Treacherous, god of intrigue and betrayal. Only Dew is somewhat respected by Demonspawn; all other Deities are considered enemies. Worship of the Outer Deity is not about faith, but the transformation of power-seekers into its slaves; the Outer Deity needs no Believers, only servants to carry out its will.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/350a882337ff298b307c0968381e36363f892f8f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For thousands of years, the Circle of Calamity has never been so peaceful, nor has there ever been such turbulent undercurrents beneath the calm. No one believes Demonspawn have suddenly learned to coexist peacefully with the outer nations, but the harsh environment of the Circle of Calamity prevents the nations from launching preemptive strikes or uncovering Demonspawn plots. The kings' withdrawal shattered the fragile internal balance; the three groups are rife with conflict, and another Lava Disaster or Obsidian Day could happen at any time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/fc53de50c42c066a15e4aee16a5f23f650756bfe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After all this, I've really said nothing at all. After all, this is the Circle of Calamity, not a place for you to seek treasure or fame. Except for a handful of truly resourceful people, you won't even get past the border outposts, let alone wrestle with Blazespawn, debate with Grimspawn, or trade with Spitespawn. Take my advice: don't aim too high or dream too big. Sure, selling Demonspawn's Elose wine in Burningland could make you a fortune, but behind every bottle is a caravan that vanished on the wasteland.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Fireside Chat[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Farther Than Farther[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]At the end of the story, let me say a bit more. We've often mentioned the "Outer Ring Nations," but is the land we stand truly the edge of Eulogize? Of course not. The so-called inner and outer are only relative concepts. Elves, Velvet Goblins, Orcs, and other races were driven out of this land by Mankind and pushed even farther away after the collapse era. The regions they occupy have always been seen as the edge of the known world.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/d6679b9c9c30f5556fddb1218ea748342451affe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Among the edge Areas, the floating islands of the Holy Elves are the most unique, located north of the Circle of Calamity, once part of the continent. A thousand years ago, the elves were a powerful race able to rival the Ancient Empire. Still, after losing the war against King Kurulek, they were expelled from the Circle of Calamity.[/p][p][/p][p]Holy Elves were the most special ones. They mastered the oldest magic veins, and tore the earth to make skyships. After the Demonspawn disaster, they turned from Mankinds' most terrifying enemy into their most reliable ally. Before the New Chapter, Mankind from east and west relied on the Holy Elves' skyships to send messages and exchange goods. In the mutual defense treaty, the Holy Elves were among the first signatories, making great sacrifices in every Cataclysm. Unfortunately, over a decade ago, the Sword Duke of the Candle Guard Family, who advocated peace with Mankind and upholding the mutual defense treaty, died in a skyship accident. Since then, the Holy Elves have become reclusive, unwilling to participate in Outer Circle affairs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/29ac9a022360f090052d0c6e1cd598ebeed9bbe7.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]North of Sasin, the Forest Elves inhabit vast woodlands. They are believers of the Grow, representing the wildest and most Blade Storm aspect of the Deity of Life. They are the most closed and conservative of the elves, rejecting any outsiders who approach the great trees and constantly clashing with the Sasin Dynasty. Further north, on the Weeping Isles, the Fallen Elves live by their ships and worship the Treacherous. Once, their ark fleets sailed all seas, forcing the Outer Ring nations to build strongholds along the coast to defend against pirate raids. But after losing wars to the Holy Elves and Chen-Yuan, and losing their leader and four ark fleets to the strange whirlpools of the Returnees Sea, the Fallen Elves fell into decline, withdrawing from most major routes. Be glad you didn't live through those fearful days—today's infamous Sharkland pirates seem gentle compared to the Fallen Elves of old.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/e81258d420d70b5e502d14613e883ca7d6674792.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Northeast of Caucaid, beyond the mighty Titan Mountains, Orcs and Velvet Goblins have established their settlements in the icy wilderness, maintaining a simple yet stable alliance. They have some contact and occasional conflict with Caucaid and Sagar. Twice driven out, the Velvet Goblins remain wary of Mankinds and resist contact with outside powers. Southwest of Chen-Yuan, mysterious Spirits live on the Shen-Yun Continent. They left the God-given Land before the Ancient Empire was founded and are the most distant from the Outer Ring races. During the Huan Dynasty, Shen-Yun Continent established a fragile connection with Divinelander, but after the fall of the Huan Dynasty, it returned to isolation.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]End of the Story, Start of the Journey[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]After the drinks and the talk, as the sun sets, it's time for you to set out. Chen-Yuan, Sasin, Caucaid, Demonspawn—for a thousand years, they come and go, all circling on the stage of Eulogize. History is the gold in people's hearts, but it is always written by people. Some become history, some create it, some are forgotten by it, and some are deliberately hidden. I've been watching you—you listen intently, sometimes silent, sometimes sneering. Someone like you won't settle for an ordinary, uneventful life.[/p][p][/p][p]The fine wine of Torch Castle is called "Dream of the Golden Trade Routes". Dreamers, those whose dreams are broken, and those whose dreams come true, all drink the same wine, but each tastes something different. Here, this bottle is on me. Take it with you as you go. Some say there is nothing new under the sun; others say new paths are made where there are none. I've told you the stories of the past—I'll wait for you to tell me the stories of the future.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/f016e1ed4d6d92ae831dbf03374435a8f89c6025.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]Oh, and one more thing... beware of those who always talk about "destiny." How many truly know what destiny is? Those who say such things are either liars... or people who want to trick you.[/p]

notes.title: My Lord, Times Have Changed! Crown and Adventure: Caucaid Faction Reveal
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="70MggG5Bex0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Crown and Adventure is a fantasy open-world strategy RPG. Players will become heroes in this world, recruiting companions, forming Legions, and establishing a nation. Explore and conquer the mythical continent “Eulogize”![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Latest Content Update: Caucaid Faction Showcase[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/c41d52aea6d727f47bbf63712b8dd2e60997baa9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the short future, players will experience the five Archduke domains of Caucaid: “Burningland”, “Libraland”, “Steelland”, “Springland”, and “Redpineland”! Burningland's trade and religious culture, Libraland's laws, Steelland's technological innovations, Springland's manor economy and chivalry traditions, and Redpineland's military heritage—all are sources of pride for the Caucaid Empire.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/412038c673a9c6e1173db55ec74d7661338e8f02.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Caucaid Empire's greatest pride lies in its ancient chivalry and its innovative abilities. Under a relatively loose power structure, each duchy excels in its own specialty—magic, military, technology, and law. However, subtle divisions between Archduke domains hinder communication and cooperation, leading each to develop unique strengths only in specific fields. Will Caucaid have a new ruler to reclaim imperial authority and achieve a new leap forward?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/9a1edb06f93bcb4200e5d244fa5fffa44dc5c629.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Traditionalists: Knights and Faith[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The chivalry tradition in Caucaid has a long history. Here, knights generally worship the Deity and draw power from it. Years of honed martial skills, full-body armor forged from fine steel, and the strength bestowed by the Deity make them invincible on the battlefield. The "iron can" image of their full armor has become the symbol of Caucaid knights.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/89dad35eb8edb9b95546dbbb4aed2deac8bdc1c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Due to the divisions among duchies, troops and heroes from each domain differ to varying degrees. Some excel at arrayed infantry and heavy armor, advancing steadily and securely.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/983378b8c0d6a313ebfd9a91be7413508ed6315b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Others specialize in armored cavalry charge, breaking through enemy lines with the power of faith and massed charge tactics.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/4bc3899ce43ab710e5bf14ed0dd9213667d630ec.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Reformists: Technology and Magic[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Not all Caucaid’s people live by tradition; there are also innovators. Some duchies' Mages popularize the use of Mana and develop powerful attack spells. On the battlefield, organized Mage groups unleash Skills to devastate enemy formations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/eb056f407b6f25fddee44aa3b3ad44cd03342d1b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The stand of reformers is Steelland, which not only achieves technological breakthroughs but also applies these advances militarily, creating a mechanized army—the “Roar Knight”. These ruthless war machines destroy all enemies before them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/c28763c0b6a18f634fd5aa064d97a5ed1e1cdc1e.png"][/img][/p][p]Cavalry, Mage, machines... Does Caucaid have other unique units? Perhaps no one knows.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/368c2f4d40de27c7e3f322e9b30f18ac660ce41e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The loose relationships among duchies allow for remarkable achievements in their respective fields, but high autonomy leads to a lack of cohesion, preventing them from combining strengths for maximum advantage. Who will be the Hero and emerge to unite them and forge a new legend?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/87c202e62f90a097252b12429819c25b451253f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Crown & Adventure demo is now available on Steam. We invite you to try it and share valuable feedback, which is crucial for our ongoing improvements. The game is tentatively scheduled for release in the second half of 2025. Thank you for your patience and support! Follow our official accounts for the latest updates![/p]

notes.title: Assemble Your Legion, Recruit Favorite Heroes! New Characters Revealed
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="R2lvUyybMp8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]"Crown and Adventure" is a fantasy open-world strategy RPG. As a Hero, you’ll recruit companions, form your own Legion, build a kingdom, and set out to explore and battle across the mystical continent of Eulogize.[/p][p][/p][p]Recruiting new heroes and taking on unknown threats! In the future release version, you'll be able to recruit about 50 unique heroes from "ChenYuan", "Caucaid", "Sasin", and the mysterious "Demonspawn" faction. Take a sneak peek at a few of them below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/3a01814ffe64deaedf817878c6570fa8aa2ee441.png"][/img][/p][p]"My sword is yours to command."[/p][p][/p][p]▍\[Lonely Death] Xiao Beige[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture： Chen-Yuan[/p][p]Class： Martial Artist[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]Xiao Beige is the greatest swordsman in Zhao-Yang and the world. When his friend Bai Qiyue was about to be executed, he entered the imperial prison with his sword just to exchange a few words. With one man and one sword, he assassinated the treacherous minister Li Motong.[/p][p]But the limit of one man is only to kill one, ten, or a hundred people... The current predicament of Zhao-Yang is not something a single swordsman can resolve. That day, before Bai Qiuyu's grave, he swore to avenge him.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/7a45e50fb22e3870c8e33aa33dda790dd1c95030.png"][/img][/p][p]"The echoes of war always sound the same. People are like autumn grass, and snow covers the bows and blades."[/p][p][/p][p]▍\[Bei-Ting Guardian] Su Li[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture： Chen-Yuan[/p][p]Class： Assassin[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]The Colonel of Long Town Guardian and commander of the Marshal Guardian. Straightforward, and highly skilled in martial arts, she acts swiftly and decisively, but shrouded in mystery—she never removes the silver mask on her face.[/p][p]Su Li's background is a complete blank. Many speculate about her identity, but Su Li only sees herself as one thing: the gate of the Bei-Ting Protectorate. Whether Demonspawn, evil cultivators, or thieves, countless lives have fallen under her twin swords.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/5478012bf4424cbd9ecbde6ab39bc9782162ab48.png"][/img][/p][p]"My friend, may the oasis grant you dew."[/p][p][/p][p]▍\[Messenger of the Sandstorm] Salem[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture： Sassin[/p][p]Class： Martial Artist[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]As known as the "Messenger of the Sandstorm", a warrior of the Order of Veil and guardian of Sasin's ancient relics. Prefers studying dynastic history over combat, but Salem's iconic armguard and sickle-shaped sword are even more renowned than his knowledge.[/p][p]The storm represents the wrath of the desert, while Salem embodies the condemnation from the sandstorm. For those who dare desecrate Grobato's history and pride, Salem will be the last one they see before death comes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/efcfaf8a07f5a55f5a5fd0a53b9138fabdb95186.png"][/img][/p][p]"Guide me to the place of deepest suffering."[/p][p][/p][p]▍\[Dew's Daughter] Camilla[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture： Sassin[/p][p]Class： Believer[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]Dew Priest, a young leader of the Dew Temple. She is the perfect image of a Dew Believer and saintess—beautiful, gracious,  and kind, as compassionate as the goddess of tears she worships.[/p][p]A subtle weariness and sadness linger in Camilla's gaze. All know that Dew perished in a war centuries ago, but Camilla often awakens at midnight, her dreams filled with scenes of the goddess's fall. Perhaps... the history we know is not the truth.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/1a2f1fab6f29d1961102c98e24200af3ce7b5235.png"][/img][/p][p]"A lifelong rival should be conquered for my entire life."[/p][p][/p][p]▍\[Princess of Winter] Yelika Ilich[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture： Caucaid[/p][p]Class： Commander[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]The eldest daughter of House Ilich, accomplished in both literature and martial arts, was exceptionally intelligent. To bear an heir and become the next queen, she has long sought a suitable partner for a long time.[/p][p]Yelika is destined to become a tyrant—not by her own will, but by the wishes of her people and the suffering of this land. She leads the people of Redpineland to expand their territory and resist the threat of Demonspawn.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/909b6280c54e036dcdcca693c5c2bfdf0fc8a9a2.png"][/img][/p][p]"You're the qualified one who walks beside me—but don't expect any more."[/p][p][/p][p]▍\[Child of the Mountains] Darcy Raven[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture： Caucaid[/p][p]Class： Commander[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]Raised under the peculiar education of House Raven, Darcy Raven and his older brother Dark Raven grew up together, but in adolescence, the family forced them to compete for the sole heir.[/p][p]This led to a series of contests that eventually escalated into internal strife and a rift between the brothers. To reclaim his birthright, Darcy Raven rebelled and declared war on his brother.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/145d6a8953a803695f613eef88c0f95f4bd5d45e.png"][/img][/p][p]"Those are shattered hearts, broken dreams."[/p][p][/p][p]▍\[Maiden of Dreamlands] Saya[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture： Demonspawn[/p][p]Class： Assassin[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]Stolas, the lord of dreams, shaped his daughter Saya according to his imagination, inspired by a cold and sorrowful dream where he once met and lived with his beloved for many years.[/p][p]Saya did not grow naturally. From infancy, she was protected by Stolas in the Magic Tower. She had never met her birth mother, and this absence became a deep pain in her heart.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/a46f0e961a582eddb46b371ab2f798588e2d6f6c.png"][/img][/p][p]"Only mediocrities should fear me, but not you."[/p][p][/p][p]▍\[Fate Weaver] Katniss Shaded[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture： Demonspawn[/p][p]Class： Assassin[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]As the priestess of the deity "The Treacherous", Katniss is as capricious as her god. Guided by foresight and instinct, she travels to Burningland in search of someone who will make this dull world 'interesting.'[/p][p]No one knows if this is yet another deception from 'The Treacherous,' but Katniss doesn't care. As long as she can banish the monotony of endless life, even a trap is better than the unending boredom day by day.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]When you wander the world, you'll meet not only friendly allies but also unexpected enemies. Here's a preview of a BOSS you'll face in the future. Good luck![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/3f8fe43dc57098b3275c4075fcf7ab671d04bfa8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]"Hmph, fragile flowers."[/p][p][/p][p]▍Mistwood Hermit[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p][/p][p]Guardian of the Mistwood, a hermit secluded deep within the woods, is rumored to have lived there for centuries and is no longer considered a human being.[/p][p]Attack anyone who enters the Mistwood. Temperamental one—sometimes warm, sometimes unapproachable.[/p][p][/p][p]Recruit heroes on your conquest journey, train them to become your most trusted partners, and overcome every threat together![/p]

In the future, we'll reveal more about the ongoing development of 'Crown and Adventure,' so stay tuned! If you're interested in our game, welcome to try our demo. We are looking forward to hearing your suggestions and thoughts![/p]

notes.title: CROWN AND ADVENTURE LEGEND STORIES | HEROES OF EULOGIZE
notes.notes: [p]Sensing everyone's fondness for the recruitable characters in "Crown & Adventure," we've created the "Heroes of Eulogize" column. Hope this helps you get to know our companions and forge new legends together in Eulogize![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/95b50d5cf97e0ce9209ec0592ac9ef6395564db7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]「To protect the mortal world is my duty. All evildoers must be punished.」[/p][p][/p][p]▍Ji Yun[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture: Chen-Yuan[/p][p]Class: Ranger[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ [/p][p]With a bow and arrows, the robe is as pure white as snow. Ji Yun, the Silver Marten Ranger, roams the snowy peaks and icy wilderness, day after day, steadfastly upholding an ancient and unfinished mission, exterminating the fanatics who lurk in the Akasha Ruins.[/p][p][/p][p]The cult of Whisper's doctrine and scripture is a fatal attraction to mortals, so those protected by Ji Yun are grateful to her. Also, to those with ulterior motives, Ji Yun is an obstacle that must be removed on their treasure-seeking journey.[/p][p][/p][p]The endless snow mountains and frozen ruins conceal the secrets of Akash, an unknown to the world. All these secrets must remain buried deep underground.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/cf2489fff64825d1535ab2a3823e586eccc7092b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]「Did you bring any sweets? No? What...」[/p][p][/p][p]▍ Luo Shanshan[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture: Chen-Yuan[/p][p]Class: Assassin[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]A single dance in rainbow attire stuns the world, making mountains and rivers seem weightless. Luo Shanshan, a renowned heroine of the Jing-Hong Sect, stands out among the younger generation with her extraordinary talent and carefree nature, much to the elders' headache.[/p][p][/p][p]In the end, the elders devised a plan to send her out from the comfort of the Jing-Hong Sect to experience the world. Perhaps good luck is part of her cultivation, for Luo Shanshan has not tasted the dangers of the martial world yet, but she can recite the varieties of pastries from every province by heart.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/2e56cc6ca7122bf81b3752abeacfabb42475c28b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]「A leaf falls, and the life ends.」[/p][p][/p][p]▍Deng Zhiqiu[/p][p]▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔ ▔▔[/p][p]Culture: Chen-Yuan[/p][p]Class: Ranger[/p][p]▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁ ▁▁[/p][p]Deng Zhiqiu, a Zhao-Yang Ranger, dreamed of being a Constable in his childhood. He was meticulous and masterful with the sword, embodying the virtues of a Zhao-Yang hero.[/p][p][/p][p]After narrowly surviving amidst the corpses of his comrades, he became taciturn and stern. Disgusted by the corrupt and incompetent government, Deng Zhiqiu angrily resigned and took his blade north to hunt the enemies who killed his comrades.[/p][p][/p][p]“A pine branch, a single flame. The earth will be my shelter, and the sword is my songs.”[/p][p][/p][p]Chen-Yuan has produced many talented heroes for a long time. Wherever these three heroes roam, they aid the needy and uphold justice, leaving behind tales of valor.[/p][p][/p][p]Seems that new turmoil is brewing in the Zhao-Yang Martial Arts World. In the next round, we'll introduce you to more masters and heroes from the Zhao-Yang Martial Arts World. Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: THE WORLD VIEW OF "CROWN AND ADVENTURE" CHAPTER 3
notes.notes: [p]Sasin... my homeland, I find myself at a loss to describe it. Should I recount the glory etched upon relief murals or the decaying remnants buried beneath endless sands? Shall I speak of the inevitable decline of our golden era into dust, or our people's futile struggle? Fortunately, "history is the gold in people's hearts"; unfortunately, that gold would no longer belong to us, never, ever.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]The Last Court[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/9564258e333f633bbf26811fdc0a4be5f8bb67ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]During the great catastrophe, the royal banners were the last to abandon our crumbling homeland. King Kurulek fought till the bitter end, yet even he was forced to retreat before the endless lava tides, splitting forces east and west. The calamity brought clarity - the King rediscovered long-abandoned duties and responsibilities. Acknowledging his failures, he bore the consequences: the court migrated to the barren western badlands, with most Grobato nobles, those who had enjoyed the greatest privilege, now shouldering the heaviest burdens. Another legion followed his most trusted general eastward, crossing the Brightvale into northern marsh grasslands.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/46faa668888a27545849d499fe2f486041cbd98a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After initial chaos, King Kurulek sought to command the Ancient Empire's fractured remains. Royal envoys traversed the continent as the King combined penitence with authority, mustering all available forces. Over eight years, he crushed three rebellions and a deification coup, dedicating all his resources to war preparations. The assembled coalition forces returned to lava-scarred homelands to battle the Outer God and its bloodthirsty minions. King Kurulek succeeded - The Seething was slain, the Outer Deity fell dormant, and Demonspawn retreated into fissures. But the cost is Dew's fall, a dozen legions destroyed, and the King's sacrifice. Most crucially, we lost our sacred homeland forever.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/278a241a627b8b6c35c3b0215b4fcf0bfce4d53f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The crown prince returned west with surviving legions, proclaiming the King's final decree: The Ancient Empire's people will choose their futures. Chen-Yuan and Caucaid seceded, and allies withdrew, leaving only the western court and eastern grassland legions struggling to preserve their former glory. This crumbling realm became known as Sasin's first dynasty.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Days Gone[/b][/h2][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/f0533ce3a1e8a773f5a5f1d6cdd01b44f1da9ce8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The stark contrast between past glory and present desolation is unbearable, yet the old nobles must struggle to survive in this barren land. To escape the harsh realities, people turn to religion, but in the Collapsed Era, the remnants of the Ancient Empire resent the gods' indifference and refuse to pray. Nostalgia for bygone eras and reverence for great monarchs birthed Sasin's unique ancestor worship. Guided by The King's Servant, the Grobato people merged history, bloodline, and death into one, enshrining King Kurulek as the source of faith, the Cult of Veil serves as its priesthood, the monarch's descendants - called Holy Scions - lead both the cult and the empire. From the Ancient Empire's corpse rises a new theocratic state, its creed illuminating the path as its people reclaim lands and rebuild civilization amidst the wastelands.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/9c73886f9f4a061e7239cd3025741684cc56724b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Separated by the Circle of Calamity, east-west communication remains arduous. But shared faith and King Kurulek's legacy maintain imperial unity. Grobato people strive against all odds to reconnect the divided realms. Since the Age of Separation, expeditions from both sides have pushed northward along coastal routes, erecting watchtowers, waystations, and fortresses like iron nails driven into ruins - a relentless campaign. Finally, when Chen-Yuan breached the Dragon-jaw Mountains in the south, eastern and western armies converged at the Circle's southern border. They raised the fortress "Kurujar", symbolizing the ancient empire's reunification and heralding the Outer Circle's New Chapter.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Elegy of the Ancient Empire[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The unification of eastern and western territories should have stabilized the Ancient Empire and restored its golden age, yet centuries of separation had fostered distinct cultural practices. Political systems and theological doctrines diverged most severely, compounded by Eastern nobles accustomed to autonomy resisting Western court authority. Without geographical barriers, the empire's halves confronted accumulated tensions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/137d5762f596e76859735e90dc07ff75bc316e09.jpg"][/img]   [/p][p]A power struggle within the Holy Scion Family ignited full-scale conflict. After Holy Scion Suhelat II's demise, his cousin, the firstborn of King Kurulek - failed in his succession bid and fled eastward. Proclaimed as Bandia I with claims of legitimacy, rival Holy Scions refused to compromise. Prolonged warfare erupted from western oases to eastern steppes. Ancient Empire's heirs clashed over legitimacy and Holy Scion dignity, demolishing Demon-spawn defense fortresses in mutual sieges. Once-united Legions turned blades against former comrades.[/p][p]   [/p][p]The Holy Scion conflict concluded with the Western court's victory. Bandia I suicided. Eastern areas acknowledged there was only one Holy Scion, but refused to acknowledge him as the Kurulek King's representation. Though retaining the crown, the court permanently lost eastern territories. Amidst the ruins, fortress Kulu Jar - the symbol of past unity - fell to Demon-spawn assault and was razed. Blazespawn renamed it "Kurujar", mocking the empire's self-sabotaged defenses. No Ancient Empire anymore! Eastern realms seceded as the Grobato Clan, establishing the priest-ruled Sagar Kingdom; the diminished western court gradually became known as the Sasin Dynasty.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Scar of Molten Sand[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Holy Scion conflicts marked the fall of the Ancient Empire, revealing the vulnerability of outer realms to the Circle of Calamity. The outer realms seemed to have forgotten that the calamity lurking beneath the lava had never truly departed. In Year 57, when the Sasin Dynasty hadn't fully recovered from civil war, Demonspawn suddenly assaulted the border fortress of Withered Sands Castle. Demonspawn Mages unleashed molten tides that cascaded over mountain passes, spreading westward for dozens of miles, searing a charred wound across the dynasty's oasis heartland.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/91ba1d5cbb9baaf0ada0cf09ebfc5578b633b11c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The remaining ancient legions were deployed piecemeal into battlefields, their centuries-old glory and thousands of lives buried in sand, barely slowing the Demonspawn advance. The royal court retreated from Sanjar to Minucius, lifting political restrictions on merchant clans en route and offering Ancient Empire relics as rewards for reinforcements. Militias and mercenaries of various races barely maintained defensive lines outside of the Minucius until the Kings' Tomb Guardian awakened, securing dynastic victory in the Battle of Minucius and driving the Demonspawn back to the Circle of Calamity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/4872d876ee04c51184c8f7b2cfbb625451190a9d.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]The Scar of Molten Sands marked Demonspawn's first large-scale invasion against Outer Circle post-Collapse Era, also called the First Melting disasters. Amidst the ruins of Withered Sands Castle, the Sasin Dynasty signed the "Final Barrier" pact with Holy Elves, Sagar, Caucaid, and Chen-Yuan, pledging joint defense against Demonspawn invasions. This pact sometimes worked in Melting Disasters, but sometimes not.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Rise and Fall of Dynasties[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Tragedy of Molten Sands exhausted the wealth inherited from the Ancient Empire, decimating the last legion. Regional warlords and rebel leaders grew powerful during this chaos, forcing the Holy Scion and priestly orders to share governance. Relocating the capital to Minucius, the Holy Scion recruited elite rebels to rebuild the Legion. Commanders of this new legion concurrently served as viceroys of major city-states, effectively confirming their authority in secular governance. The Holy Scion maintained dominance over all Viceroy family lineages through control of two elite legions and ancient mana-crafted artifacts inherited from the Ancient Empire.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/54d9f88cabca808863d8e7f12b586be71105d7b3.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]In Year 124, the visionary monarch Shahmet · Sasin ascended the throne of the Second Dynasty. This Holy Scion wielded absolute power for over six decades, expanding into the White Desert, repelling Forest Elves raiders, excavating Kurujar ruins, and promoting the spice trade. His reputation reached its zenith through these military and administrative achievements. In his twilight years, Shahmet grew unwilling to share power with viceroys, conspiring with the sorcerer of The King's Servants to have the Cult of Veil deify him as a sacred sovereign, attempting to transcend mortal limits and centralize all authority. When this plot leaked in Year 187, temple priests and regional viceroys united to disrupt Shahmet's ritual at King's Rest, entombing the "Greatest Holy Scion" and expunging his name from historical records. The Second Dynasty collapsed, replaced by the Third Dynasty under descendants of King Kurulek's second son.[/p][p][/p][p]The eighty-year Third Dynasty witnessed twelve different Holy Scions and constant political turmoil. Viceroys warred against each other until Year 273, when bandit lords from the outlaw city: Gor · Aman exploited conflicts between the Holy Scion's Legion and Haman Province's Viceroy to sack Minucius. The last Holy Scion perished in this chaos.[/p][p][/p][p]The death caused seismic shockwaves across three Provinces. As the dynasty teetered on the brink of collapse, the Cult of Veil awakened the tomb guardians from King's Rest Place, crushing separatist warlords with overwhelming force. They installed another Kurulek descendant as the new Holy Scion. After destroying Gor · Aman, the Fourth Dynasty was established when regional Viceroys paid homage to Minucius. With the Tomb Guardian Legion as its backbone and the Cult of Veil as its voice, the Fourth Dynasty finally established stable political authority and administrative systems. For over a century, no collapse has threatened its reign.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]A Ship Sailing on Quicksand[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]In Sasin, the time seems to have come to a standstill. Unlike Chen-Yuan and Caucaidian, who forge ahead into the future, the people of Sasin prefer seeking direction from tombs and archives. Ancient means better - nobles consider adherence to old ways as fashion, Scholars regard studying ancient arts as orthodoxy, and even the tactical innovations of Legion Soldiers lean toward the awe-inspiring Legion of the Ancient Empire, rather than valuing new developments in gunpowder, forging, or thaumaturgy. Ironically, ancient War Machines excavated from tombs, the King's Servant arcana, and immortal Warriors prove no less formidable than modern doctrines. The legacy of the Ancient Empire still has much to offer this dynasty. Fairness compels us to admit: Kurulek King's Warriors still guard his bloodline, ancient The King's Servants still manipulate court politics in shadows, past glories still guide descendants of the Ancient Empire on their campaigns..."The older, the mightier" seem more than empty words.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/bb50a208baa852aebbda494c3c69ce7e0e89edff.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]All know Sasin is a ship trapped in quicksand. Even with the captain and crew straining, they merely delay its slide toward The End. Faced with barrenness, it sails into history, drawing strength and pride from glorious yesteryears. But when priests' hymns fade and sand-laden winds rush through windows, people remember they're merely surviving amidst the corpse of the Ancient Empire. Perhaps the Holy Scion and priests all understand that the splendid past has vanished beyond retrieval, and the Sasin people are trekking toward mirages. Without that beautiful illusion, they couldn't endure until the next oasis.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/39a6de7b2a4cb954e4de725b8af5f6c80ae573d6.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]Among outer realm nations, Sasin is far from the richest but undoubtedly holds the most secrets. Ancient Empire, The King's Servant, King of Kings, departed Godness - Dew... Their mysteries lie beneath yellow sands, concealed in sepulchral coffins. "History is the gold in people's hearts" - sometimes becoming gold in their hands. You may choose to venture into sandy seas, seeking treasures and truths lost among grains, doing what I dare not. Well, friend... May oases grant you dew.[/p]

notes.title: THE WORLD VIEW OF "CROWN AND ADVENTURE" CHAPTER 2
notes.notes:
Let us turn our gaze from the distant west to the expansive eastern lands. Caucaid - another great realm beyond the Outer Circle - now reveals its splendor and majesty.

The Stirl royal domain and seven Archduke states form this burgeoning empire, where youthful passion grows within ancient frameworks. As a civilization contemporaneous with the Ancient Empire, its history proves equally remarkable.

[b][h3]Eastward Journey[/h3][/b]

The story begins, as it always does, in the Year of Collapse. While the Divinelander fled west in haste and the people of the Ancient Empire migrated southward, the Caucaidian from the eastern territories of the Ancient Empire, under the protection of the last four legions, crossed the east mountain passes into the vast wilderness.

After entering the eastern plains, Orc clans chose to continue northward over the Titan Mountains following brief conflicts, while Velvet Goblin craftsmen secured autonomy in reserved lands by trading their exquisite metalworks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/f5257eeb6480c89b2f1e5c37f28118de5a5d8096.jpg[/img]

Having established footholds in the east, Caucaidian received imperial decrees from the royal court. Driven by reverence for the King of Kings and bitter hatred for their enemies, the last four legions resembled and marched west along the escape route to join royal armies at the Circle of Calamity.

Three years later, the decimated forces returned eastward bearing royal spoils and an edict symbolizing independence.

Using surviving legion forces as their backbone, Caucaidian established their realm in the east, naming the land after their people: Caucaid, meaning "Predators" in the Ancient Empire tongue.

[b][h3]Age of Rule[/h3][/b]

Unlike the fragmented clans of Divinelander that later unified, the original Caucaid existed as a nominally united nation-state. Basing their territorial claims on legion divisions, the Caucaidians dispersed to conquer their promised lands.

Four legions formed the initial four Provinces: the northern Province adjacent to the Circle of Calamity, the southern plains Province along the Titan Mountains, the western highland Province conquering mountain ranges, and the central Province occupying fertile lowlands.
		
With the addition of the Ancient Empire nobles who served as mediators and chroniclers, five factions erected a stone-stepped platform at their initial meeting grounds. Here, they resolved disputes and deliberated on matters of state through the council, marking the origin of the Parliament of Stone Step.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/62d93ad26fcf99da6b53f295232ce4df6c25f744.jpg[/img]

Over two centuries of territorial expansion and fertile land conquests, the Caucaid people flourished. Distinct cultural customs and ethnic identities began taking shape across various Provinces. Gradually, the unified kinship among Caucaidian fractured into "us and them" divisions between different Provinces. As easily habitable lands were exhausted and resource allocation grievances accumulated, once-solid alliances between provinces developed cracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/c5a52a7f5449f17612c5f6ae53fa25072073a443.jpg[/img]

Following the first Melting Disaster, the threat of Demonspawn invasions threw the complacent Caucaidian into panic. Northern Provinces bordering the Circle of Calamity demanded greater resources, their aggressive stance alienating other provinces. Compounded by ongoing resource disputes, the Parliament of Stone Step gradually lost its ability to mediate conflicts between provinces.

[b][h3]The Lettuce and the Crest[/h3][/b]

The growing power of northern Orc clans threatened the Plains Province along Titan Mountains' southern foothills. This Province rapidly aligned with Northern Province, creating a dangerous standoff between four northeastern and southwestern provinces that rendered the Parliament of Stone Step completely dysfunctional.

In Year 85, a dispute over ownership of a lettuce cart escalated into armed conflict between Northern Province and Central Province forces. The clash rapidly spread, erupting into an unprecedented civil war.

Four Provinces' legions waged protracted battles across central fertile lands, trading victories while thousands of Caucaidian fell to kinsmen's blades. The co-governance era's accumulated wealth dwindled rapidly as war weariness and opposed sentiments grew among the populace.

In Year 108, Central Province crumbled first under rebellion-induced economic collapse, withdrawing from hegemony struggles. Subsequently, the isolated Highland Province underwent a series of rebellions and dissolutions.

Before Northern Province and Plains Province could contend for their rivals' legacy, they disintegrated amidst successive uprisings and rebellions. The Lettuce Wars concluded, leaving Caucaid in ruins awaiting reconstruction.

Following the collapse of the Ancient Empire's co-governance model of Provinces, numerous city-states emerged across Caucaidian lands, locked in perpetual warfare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/ebf81c2896d85708186396ad8eb31cdc3928925c.jpg[/img]

As time progressed, city-states merged through blood ties, forming over a dozen kingdoms. The mergers, alliances, and marriages between Families eventually gave birth to four powerful realms: Mountainspire in the southwest, Illich in the north, Helton in the south, and Brightflame at the heartland.

The Caucaid has returned to an era of quadrilateral confrontation, while kings' aspirations to dominate the realm and reunify the lands deepen with each passing year.

[b][h3]Age of Trembling[/h3][/b]

The Kingdom of Helton initiated the first attempt at conquering the realms. In the Year 280, following the demise of Ampar IV, the King Brightflame, Helton intervened in the royal succession dispute, ultimately leading to armed conflict. Both sides rallied allies and plunged headlong into the quagmire of war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/06483a8a008280a475f99549a518103b26202459.jpg[/img]

In the Year 289, a decisive battle erupted south of the White River, recorded in history as the War of the Four Kings. The Helton-Mountainspire alliance suffered defeat, with King Tennant of Helton captured and surrendering. The first conquest attempt ended in failure... yet this marked not the era's conclusion, but the first clarion call announcing its arrival.

The humiliated Tennant returned to his capital only to be swiftly overthrown, succeeded by his ambitious third son, Mordred. In the Year 302, capitalizing on Brightflame's royal demise and Illich's frost calamity, the long-dormant Kingdom of Helton struck northward, crushing Brightflame's main forces at White River to avenge past shame.

The following year saw Helton forces shatter Illich's reinforcements at Brightflame's capital, Edgard, extinguishing the Brightflame realm. Queen Sophia of Illich surrendered alone in the royal tent. In 305, Mordred launched western campaigns, citing Mountainspire's breached covenant, seizing two-thirds of its territory as the royal family fled into the mountains.

Thus, save the autonomous Dawnspring Duchy, "Thorn King" Mordred nearly unified the entire Caucaid.

Though Thorn King embodied war, his cruelty and warmongering destabilized the expanding realm. As discontent brewed and revolts erupted, Year 312 witnessed his undefeated streak broken at the Springland campaign. The executioner's noose lost its terror over restless rebels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/2d39d38935f0af1aec84966913bb107598b66477.jpg[/img]

Within three years, Illych, Highland, and even Brightflame restored sovereignty. Even Helton Kingdom saw noble-led revolts. The Scourge of Nations ultimately perished with its capital in Mana Storm's crucible.

Following Tyrant Helton's death, Caucaid entered peaceful years. Former Helton territories fell under House Bianchi from the Springland duchy, which became independent as Dawnspring Kingdom.

The five newborn kingdoms signed the Edgard Pact, ushering in thirty years of peace. This phase witnessed religions' widespread propagation.

The major religions established during wartime were amplified during this period, with Believer numbers growing daily while doctrines and scriptures were refined. Representative examples included The Rising faith from the central plains, The Rebuke faith from mountainous kingdoms, and The Grow faith from eastern wilderness.

[b][h3]Lion's Ascension[/h3][/b]

After the Edgard Agreement expired, power struggles resumed among kingdoms. Yet this conquest proved brief yet decisive - Stirl Kingdom secured alliance through marriage with Springland, while prolonged military support won over warlords from Illych Kingdom.

Year 362, when Springland's King Aquos passed, Stirl King Jepard, being Aquos' son-in-law, claimed the Springland crown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/f0a7aae7e9333ea8cb6cc0dc3e5ac2d35a980634.jpg[/img]

The merger of two powers triggered panic among Nations. Highland, Bianchi, and Illych formed a coalition against the Stirl Kingdom.

Year 363 summer, King Boris I of Ilyich's death triggered succession conflicts between heirs and military nobles. Stirl Kingdom's intervention escalated into full mobilization among allied states, sparking the War of Conquest.

That winter, Spring Archduke Arsenault outflanked Redpineland via Titan Mountains, capturing all Ilyich territories except the capital Gwana. Next summer at West Valley, his cavalry struck allied forces' rear as Jopad's Cavalry shattered their main army. Jopad·Stirl showed remarkable clemency, dissolving resistance through strategic alliances, treaties, and marital bonds.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/7f2e98067451f778ae58159cb90719068f4de336.jpg[/img]

After crushing House Belning's costly rebellion in Year 365, Jopad Stirl was crowned Emperor at Edgard, renamed Lionfang Fortress, now the capital of the Caucaid Empire.

The five kingdoms were reorganized into seven Archduke territories. Houses Ilyich, Ridge, Spring royalty, and Stirl war heroes received Archduke titles. Jopad established the Imperial Household Council to manage noble affairs, appointing House Spring, instrumental in the conquest, as its leadership. Under legal frameworks from Fort of Justice, the empire achieved unprecedented political stability.

[b][h3]Beyond the Crown[/h3][/b]

Though the Stirl Family secured the imperial diadem, numerous political marriages, negotiations, and compromises during unification prevented the Caucaid Empire from establishing Chen-Yuan-style centralized governance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/b5b2eb4752e44aa61fd352364126d6bf583c10ab.jpg[/img]

Beyond the royal domain housing Lionfang Fortress, most imperial territories remain under Archduke rule, maintaining administrative frameworks largely unchanged from the kingdom era. Each duchy retains its Parliament of Stone Step, though Archdukes still wield substantial executive authority.

The imperial family exercises no direct control over duchies, requiring all edicts to be channeled through the Imperial Household Council to dukes for implementation, effectively making the Council's leader the empire's de facto prime minister.

Caucaid's decentralized governance effectively leveraged each duchy's strengths: Burningland's commerce and religious culture, Libraland's legal codes, Steelland's technological innovations, Springland's manorial economy and knightly traditions, Lunaland's Mana research, Redpineland's military heritage, Sharkland's maritime trade and fleets... all became pillars of imperial pride.

Ever pioneering, Caucaidians maintained their expansionist spirit post-unification. Religious disputes soon ignited the "Quagmire War" against the northern Sagar Kingdom. The imperial army and The Rising church forces have been fighting the Sagar people who worship "The Silence" in northern swamps for ten years, leaving both sides exhausted. During the recent Third Flooding Catastrophe, imperial troops endured a hundred-day siege at Orost in Redpineland, ultimately driving Demonspawn back to Circle of Calamity through a miraculous event. Beneath our feet, trade disputes between Burningland and Chen-Yuan continue escalating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/0b05c6f0bbdf2b38582e84e7f5043fc9796fde72.jpg[/img]

Throughout Caucaidian history, warfare has filled nearly every parchment page. War represents society's most extreme collision, forging deepest calamities and most radical ideologies. Whether internal or external, Caucaid remains far from "stable", yet this land overflows with opportunities from every crevice. "Chaos is the cradle of progress" - if you truly believe this, seek audience with the local lord. But remember: those who live by the sword die by it. Chaos can forge a glorious future, yet snatch it away just as swiftly.

notes.title: NEW CONTENT REVEAL: BEASTS UNITS! CROWN AND ADVENTURE DEV NOTES
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=CFl09xROAAc;full][/previewyoutube]

"Crown and Adventure" is a fantasy open-world strategy RPG. As a Hero, you’ll recruit companions, form your own Legion, build a kingdom, and set out to explore and battle across the mystical continent of Eulogize.

In this Dev note, we’re excited to introduce our developing soldier unit: the Beasts. In the future version,  a wide range of heroes and soldiers from the "Chen-Yuan", "Caucaid", "Sasin", and the mysterious "Demonspawn" faction will be recruitable. Train them into an unstoppable legion for your conquest journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/d833d6f4b2524b325b81e758570dcfa22d962ada.jpg[/img]

The Beast is a truly special force. They possess incredible combat abilities and an awe-inspiring presence on the battlefield. Of course, anything has a price—these powerful Beast units require more leadership to deploy. Deploy your Beast units strategically to maximize your overall combat efficiency. Let’s take a look at the Beast units in development for each faction!

[b][h3]Stone Spirit Turtle[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/d8fa33c7edc1da7eae245c59dc752f3cdb996f29.jpg[/img]

Rumor has it that during the northern invasion, a colossal divine turtle emerged from the desert sea and blocked the enemy army. As it lay dying, it shattered the Dragon Bridge, saving the southern bank from disaster. Afterward, the people of Bei-Ting carved statues of the divine turtle from the broken stones of Dragon Bridge, placing them proudly on both sides of the long bridge. Bei-Ting people believe it will awaken again in times of crisis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/ed39316a5d5cd3d30ab81824c288cc7f6dd1466e.jpg[/img]

The Stone Spirit Turtle is a Beast unit from the Chen-Yuan faction, serving as the backbone character. Not only does it boast massive health points, but it also provides an aura buff that enhances the abilities of nearby Chen-Yuan units, making it the true "Divineland Fortress". On top of that, the Stone Spirit Turtle packs powerful combat abilities and can hold its own in any fight.

[b][h3]King’s Pride[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/048b5ae48fff012560ef4fef80a3885c9575a12e.jpg[/img]

Every head of the Stirl family must earn the approval of the lion pride leader before taking their place, proving themselves a true Stirl with courage and virtue. Once recognized, the family head gains the loyalty of the entire pride. The pride leader is not only the king’s Intimate and protector but also a symbol of the king’s power and dignity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/d6b526cb9214f101b6f3301c68f916bee8ce3903.jpg[/img]

As the embodiment of bravery and strength, the King’s Pride will charge into enemy lines first, using its powerful melee abilities to break through defenses. As the pride leader, it also boosts the attack power of nearby Beast units, becoming a spearhead of any Beast team.

[b][h3]Soul Platform[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/e50b6363d44d4dce87d81eb139bcec5b503a72ab.jpg[/img]

A war machine from the Ancient Empire, this floating platform is powered by secret art. The embedded runes unleash bursts of energy, creating devastating mini Mana storms around their targets. The crystals that once powered the Soul Altar have long since faded, and now the platform is powered by a ritual maintained by several veiled priests. In a sense, it has truly become soul-bound to the high platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/e8d9c08a1fa21bd999209c006e90405b22f5b542.jpg[/img]

As a Beast unit with area magician attack abilities, the Soul Platform features a unique design and outstanding combat abilities. Because it requires several Sasin priests to operate, it only reaches its full potential when Sasin units are nearby.

[b][h3]Calamity Titan[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/7743e12b7059f58dd7d744c2842ff164c6b83b02.jpg[/img]

Born in the molten abyss, this massive creature is driven by endless rage and pain, seeking to unleash destruction on everything. Its withered body is filled with flowing lava, and its chest is hollow—these monsters can no longer be considered living creatures. These terrifying beings have only appeared on battlefields for about a century. Are they nightmares born from the earth, or evil spirits forged by the dark magic of outer gods? The secrets behind this remain a mystery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/3bbd948c582f13fac4e2f36678a4db082793a963.jpg[/img]

As one of the most powerful units of the Demonspawn, the Calamity Titan not only boasts fearsome combat abilities but also grants combat bonuses to the nearby Beast units. It’s a nightmare for humans during the molten disaster, yet some human heroes can even command it—how this is possible remains unknown.

Inspire your team's potential by strategically combining these Beast units with others, experimenting with different unit combinations, and building your own legendary Legion!
