"When discussing the nations surrounding the outer ring, we always talk about Chen-Yuan first. You came to Torch Castle cause you want to embark on the Golden Road from here, intending to go to Chen-Yuan, right? To earn gold from someone, you must cater to their preferences first; to gain wealth from a land, you must understand its customs and culture. Chen-Yuan, the land where the divine dragon coils, the center of the world, is perfectly suited as our opening."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/7cab55fdca3de45a24bb3f25dc7a4c3a46c48180.png[/img]

[h3]The Ashes of South[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/743e83e0fbfcd16b79dbe9a5330d9e82e35178ff.png[/img]

The southern part of the Divine Land was once an endless snowfield, but the terrifying Great Collapse caused the mountains to crumble, the mantle to shift, and the heat of lava to melt the snow and thaw the ice, irrigating the vast lands south of the mountains. The Ancient Empire and the Divine Land were destroyed on the collapse day, and survivors had to flee. Under the escort of three Legions, the southern tribes of the Ancient Empire crossed the snow-capped plateau, migrating further south to the wild lands. The migrants crossed the mountains, and they were pleasantly surprised to find the land was not as barren as expected. The fertile mountains and rivers, the interwoven network of waterways, the rich terrain, and the distinct four seasons... it was simply a gift from the Deity! The migrants took root in this land, attempting to rebuild civilization south of the ashes, and this land was also called Divineland, the god-given fertile land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/b9ab7bd590a5dbdf2c565243c70ba4ef0ade2997.jpg[/img]

Years later, an envoy from King Kurulek came from the west, sounding the horn of war and calling for revenge. Despite the unhealed wounds in their hearts, the Divinelander responded to the king's call, sending a massive army composed of three Legions and seven auxiliary forces. They were personally reviewed by King Kurulek, accompanied the king's tent, and were thrown into the fiercest battles. At the end, only one-third of this army survived and returned.

The era of war ended, and according to King Kurulek's posthumous edict, Divinelanders are no longer to pledge allegiance to the Ancient Empire; the fate of Divinelanders is handled by themselves. In the joy of freedom, Divinelanders successively established several clans on the Divine Land, cultivating their abundant homeland.

[h3]Huan Dynasty[/h3]

The Divine Land is a rich and fertile land, but not without danger. Roaming beasts, malicious foreign tribes, and mysterious untouchable entities, they are significant threats that the individual clans can't face to. After numerous alliances and disputes, the Huan clan, retaining the only Ancient Empire Legion, became the overlord of the Divinelanders, uniting the clans into a complete and unified nation. This nation's first name was also called Huan, meaning the unfallen fortresses and majestic walls. the empire was initially established to protect its people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/16db47f95e0ddc11a27fbd26ad88c3bba546f1d0.png[/img]

After the establishment of the Huan Dynasty, it immediately began addressing threats from all sides. The Huan Emperor dispatched a powerful army composed of various clans to march north, expelling the roaming Demonspawn, and built a strong city in the north, known as Loong City; dispatched the Luan clan, skilled in construction, to the east to carve through the towering Dragon-jaw Mountains, searching for the legendary fertile lands in the east; ordered the unruly Sui clan to move south, developing the southern smoky jungles, expanding territories while consuming their strength, stabilizing the central heartland. Outside the court, the Huan Dynasty made a pact with the Ascender sect, which sought the secrets of primordial Ki. The empire provided resources and protection to the Ascender, while the Ascender handled the threats of mountain spirits and wild creatures for the empire.

[h3]Open the Mountains[/h3]

With magic, machines, and the dedication of several generations, the Luan clan carved a magnificent and wide mountain pass through the Dragon-jaw Mountains and built a fortress there, known as Duan-Long Fort. After hundreds of years, the Mankind of east and west reunited, restarting trade and exchanges, marking the beginning of a new era. The Luan clan, having made outstanding contributions, was granted vast lands in the east by the Huan Dynasty, growing ever stronger and more prosperous.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/54fbf3bd787e504cecdbbdd08dbad43635fb8d9a.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Northern Calamity[/h3]

In the Era year 145, Grimspawn led the Demonspawn army, and launched a massive attack, assaulting the long-peaceful Huan Dynasty, marking the second Circle of Calamity in history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/7624b0eed0c21df29e1bfd6a695711e4b8ad523e.png[/img]

The sudden attack caused significant losses to the Huan Dynasty. The frontier defenses were breached, and Demonspawn raiders wreaked havoc in the extensive area of Huan, causing widespread destruction in the empire's heartland. Only Loong City was holding out for reinforcements. After the initial panic, the Huan Dynasty quickly responded. With the six elite legions of the sides and allied forces, the Huan Dynasty achieved a great victory in the final battle at Loong City, ultimately driving out the Demonspawn.

Subsequently, the Huan Dynasty undertook massive construction in the Bei-Ting Area, building a vast frontier defense system centered around Loong City and establishing the special military system "Loong City Guardian". The garrison troops were directly supported by the court and highly independent, belonged to the emperor, and didn't have to take orders from anyone else. "Loong City Guardian" focused on countering the Demonspawn threat and was prohibited from engaging in internal disputes.

[h3]Majestic Mountains[/h3]

The Huan Dynasty lasted for six hundred years, but ultimately, it was limited by its clan alliance structure, falling into decline after the northern calamity and gradually losing people's support. In the Era year 336, with the support of major clans, the Luan clan raised an army and entered the Capital Region, deposing the last Huan Emperor. The Luan clan leader, Luan Feng, claimed the divine right of an emperor and became the first emperor of the Luan Dynasty. After that, the empire capital was moved to Luan Town, establishing the Luan Empire.

During Luan Feng's reign, he felt the inadequacy and looseness of the Huan Dynasty's system and implemented sweeping reforms internally. The Luan Dynasty stripped other clans of their military power, centralized command under the court; reclaimed clan territories for the central government, established counties and prefectures, dispatched officials for management; unified the nation's weights and measures, language, and currency, eliminating clan barriers and fostering a national identity of "Divinelanders." Due to the unexpectedly smooth transition of power, local clans still held influence, threats are buried deep beneath the surface of calm. The Luan Emperor's reforms faced obstacles. Under the resistance of the clans, reform measures encountered difficulties locally, causing widespread public discontent and continuous uprisings.

[h3]Xuan Lin's Northern Expedition[/h3]

The third Circle of Calamity severely damaged the Sagal, an ancient northern kingdom. The outer ring nations realized that mere defense would only lead to passive destruction. In the Era year 363, the Luan Emperor passed away, and his son Luan Yuan ascended the throne. The county and prefecture system reforms were already struggling, the new emperor's foundation was unstable and unable to command respect, and the state was in jeopardy, with only the powerful army still in the hands of the royal family. Therefore, Luan Yuan urgently needed a monumental military achievement to subdue the ministers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/3deb13ae71a336064eec86cec7ef2772225ce6ae.png[/img]

The following year, after detecting the movements of the Demonspawn, Luan Yuan, ignoring the opposition of the Loong City Guardian Troop, appointed Xuan-Lin, the Grand General of Bei-Ting, as the commander, leading the six elite legions to launch a northern expedition. The Luan Dynasty army crossed the Dragon Bridge, sweeping across the broader, dismantling Demonspawn settlements, greatly weakening the Demonspawn, and nipping the brewing invasion in the bud.

The Luan Empire achieved the greatest victory against the Circle of Calamity among the outer ring nations, successfully thwarting the impending disaster, but the cost was also staggering. The expedition rapidly consumed the astonishing wealth accumulated by the previous Huan Dynasty over a century, causing the heartland, where not directly facing the Demonspawn threat, to judge the expedition. 

Moreover, after the Demonspawn recovered from their initial shock, the expeditionary force suffered heavy casualties during the retreat, with a casualty rate exceeding half, and the six elite legion almost lost their combat ability. The "victory" of the northern expedition did not bring an overwhelming reputation to the emperor but instead depleted the sharpest blade in the royal family's hands. The powerful clans in various counties were eager to move, and the Divine Land was in turmoil.

[h3]Wei-Chuan Rebellion[/h3]

In the Era year 371, during an emperor's western tour, the Luan Emperor was assassinated in Wei-Chuan, but fortunately survived. The Luan Emperor was furious, ordering the Li clan, a powerful local faction in Wei-Chuan, to capture the rebels, resulting in thousands being implicated. Li You, the patriarch of the Li clan, submitted a petition to admonish the emperor, but was branded a rebel by the court, forcing him to raise an army in rebellion. The rebellion swiftly spread nationwide. Within months, the Luan Empire lost control of most provinces, plunging the empire into a prolonged civil war.

[h3]The Establishment of Chen-Yuan[/h3]

During the years of civil war, the righteous army led by the Wei River Li clan experienced several ups and downs, eventually defeating most warlords and unifying the east of the Dragon Bridge, with only Bei-Ting and Luan remaining in the hands of the Luan Emperor. In the Era year 379, General Xuanlin was assassinated, the Loong City garrison surrendered, the righteous army captured Luan Town, and the Luan Dynasty ended. The Li clan established the capital in Zhao-Lin, and renamed the original area capital as Wei-Chuan. The new emperor appointed officials and founded the Chen-Yuan Empire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/687227a27db6fce3db66cfbe6e27285c69b07eb2.png[/img]

The clans across the land rejoiced, believing that the "harsh policies" of the Luan Dynasty were about to end, and the Divineland would return to the clan alliance system of the Huan Dynasty. Unexpectedly, Emperor Li You fully inherited the reform legacy of the Luan Dynasty and, relying on his rising Reputation and battle-hardened elite troops, implemented even more radical measures. The exhausted clan forces from the war were powerless to resist the new empire, and although there were sporadic resistances, they could not stop the wheels of the era.

By the end of Era year 381, Chen-Yuan conquered the southern Sui clan territory, establishing Nan-Xi, and the last clan forces were suppressed; at the beginning of  Era year 396, the Chen-Yuan navy and the Caucaid fleet drove out the Fallen Elves pirates entrenched in the South Ocean, reclaiming Chu-Yun Island, bringing the Divine Land to completeness. From the eastern Dragon-jaw natural barrier to the boundless western desert. From the snowy peaks of Loong City in the north to the smoky jungles in the south. An unprecedentedly vast empire rose in the center of the Outer Ring, under the dragon banner. The Divinelanders created a miracle, and this miracle is not yet over.

[h3]Under the Dragon Banner[/h3]

Since the founding of Chen-Yuan, in just over fifty years, it has risen from the ashes of bloody civil war to become a colossal entity unparalleled in the world. Whether it was the former Emperor Li You or the current Emperor Li Wentai, both are wise and enlightened emperors, capable of steering the Chen-Yuan chariot swiftly along the broad road. But... such a large and unified dynasty overly relies on its helmsman. If the person on the throne is merely of average talent, where will the empire head?

The achievements of Chen-Yuan are so dazzling, and the challenges it faces are equally severe: internally, the conflict between the "Academy Faction" controlling the court and the "Military Merit Faction" at the borders is sharp and almost irreconcilable; the clan forces in the six-sided broaders have bowed and submitted, but their foundations remain solid. Externally, Chen-Yuan has had frictions with the eastern Caucaid Empire and the western Sasin dynasty, not to mention the Circle of Calamity is just to the north, and the Demonspawn, though temporarily withdrawn, will not easily give up. Outside the court, the Hong-Yi College, Gui-Gu Sect, and other sects beyond the world have no interest in politics but have never let the court rest easy; in the mountains and wilderness, those mountain spirits and wild creatures that were forced into hiding under the Huan Dynasty's conquests are showing signs of resurgence.

The common people can enjoy peace and prosperity, but the emperor and ministers may not rest easy. The center of the world is also the center of the storm, and before the emperor lies a complex chess game, where one wrong move could lead to total defeat. At this moment, an idle piece can often play an unexpected role, and from an unknown pawn to a name in history, it only takes one step. The people heading to Chen-Yuan are endless, but who will be so fortunate to enter the game and stir the winds and clouds? If this is also your goal, then pack your bags and head west. Friend, your journey has just begun.

notes.title: JOIN THIS FANTASY WAR EPIC! CROWN AND ADVENTURE ATTENDING STEAM WARGAME FEST!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=PBVoZC37Q4w;full][/previewyoutube]

The open-world fantasy RPG "Crown and Adventure" joins the Steam Wargame Fest from April 29 to May 6! Heroes, build your legion on the Eulogize, recruit unique characters and soldiers, and create your legend in this world! The game is about to launch in late 2025, and our free demo is now live on Steam. Jump in and add "Crown and Adventure" to your wishlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/555e2fc45da66d3304c4ef0443d08c4cced7e4d3.png[/img]

In "Crown and Adventure", you can recruit heroes as your generals, and collect your favorite soldiers from the whole world, forming a powerful legion to be your blade and shield. In the current demo, you can recruit up to 7 Heroes and try out a part of [Chen-Yuan] soldier units. In the release version, you'll have over 50 recruitable heroes and all units from the 4 main factions: Chen-Yuan Empire, Caucaid, Sasin, and Demonspawn. Additionally, there are some special factions to discover and recruit!

[h3]Chen-Yuan[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/a7ba0e049f377cdf0eee0f60c4c4cdaeb66874f9.png[/img]

Each major faction has its unique unit traits. Chen-Yuan units are well-balanced and focus on teamwork and formation tactics. As a unified empire, they follow orders and work together seamlessly, rarely showing any weakness and excelling in head-on battles.

[h3]Caucaid[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/02437b54b1cbab48c706f85d4e07f99f22c6b794.png[/img]

Caucaid is made up of six Archduke states, each with its strengths. Their main army is versatile but not outstanding in any one area. Each type of Caucaid soldier has strong combat ability, but because the six Archduke states are loosely connected, their teamwork isn't the best. Due to Caucaid focus on technology and magician research for decades, they have a real edge on the battlefield.

[h3]Sasin[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/748399479e251d6618f7e7efeda3107c82212767.png[/img]

Sasin inherited the main legacy of the Ancient Empire, using mysterious rituals and formations to unleash terrifying power from their Soldiers. Their armies are mainly made up of fast-light infantry and cavalry, supported by elite warriors on the front lines, making them invisible. But if they lose their formation or rituals, they may be crashed at the moment.

[h3]Demonspawn[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/dd6196bb49bcc04565e8c2cd73f63e61b21e21f3.png[/img]

The Demonspawn can also be recruited by players. Their powerful legion is made up of three clans, each with its own specialty and top-tier single-unit ability. But to get the Demonspawn server, you'll need to meet some tough requirements. Also, the three clans don't always get along, so teamwork can be tricky and sometimes even backfire.

[h3]Strategy[/h3]

Besides each unit's unique abilities, changing your formation to gain different buffs, makes them stronger in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/a33a1bf31f0b73cd92b8b8bc2e7497c9323842de.png[/img]

For example, a Ki Practiser grants Resistance and Range Block buffs to adjacent units in all four directions, making them perfect for the center of your Team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/0c2c376fe87c82012e1f15b626526bb0c786a204.png[/img]

Senior Escorts claim special bonuses from Chen-Yuan units, and with the right Chen-Yuan faction deployment, the whole team will be boosted. Hero units have an even bigger impact on your formation. For example, in this demo, "Deng Zhiqiu" provides an aura that boosts all Escorts and melee Units. Try building your unique team around the passive ability auras of your hero units!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/b38f532c51813a1fddb9fabe4599aaffe8aa6ff8.png[/img]

Within the same unit type, you can use "Promote" to upgrade them into upper-class soldiers with new stats and ability effects. Some soldiers on the upgrade tech path have unique abilities or other special traits, so you might want to keep these soldiers as they are and not promote them further, but still want them to be useful in future battles. You can use the "Level Mastery" feature to raise their level cap to 50. But they will no longer be promoted further. Both "Promote" and "Level Mastery" will become available when a unit reaches its current level cap. Strategically choose what suits your target and build your dream team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/221eff431ad128c96ea2269d92c448522fcb4296.png[/img]

Wondering where to test out your legion? We've got you covered!
In the demo, you can visit the [Yamen] in any city and talk to the [Shrieff] to access the manoeuvre feature and challenge your legion's clone

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/f6d88d81b9c0c4d1f5816405bf9d61b3cbf4812b.png[/img]

This feature will be added in the future release version, and more new content is on the way. Please stay tuned and subscribe to our official channel!

Build your Legion in this fantasy world and lead them to glory on the battlefield! "Crown and Adventure" is attending Steam Wargame Fest, welcome to experience our demo!

notes.title: THE WORLD VIEW OF "CROWN AND ADVENTURE" CHAPTER 0
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=yyK4LK6OCSg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

"Everything has its price," is the first lesson I learned on my adventure. You paid for my drink, I return the favor with a story. The Sasin people often say, "History is the gold in people's hearts," and it's the only thing of value I have. Come closer, this story will be a bit long.
——Ashde Fayar

[h3]The Vast Land and Spirits[/h3]

How much do you know about this land? Not just Chen-Yuan, Sasin, or Caucaid, but the entire land. Eulogize, the Land of Praise, is called by the same syllable in all languages, but its history is widely debated. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/54fbf3bd787e504cecdbbdd08dbad43635fb8d9a.jpg[/img]

The old books from Divineland, steles from the Ancient Empire, and even Demonspawn Aktur record vastly different histories, and I try to extract the truth from them.

[h3]The First Movement[/h3]

The existence of matter does not depend on anyone's will, but Deity brings life. The primordial Deities wandered among the stars, and one of them accidentally came to this world, taking root in the murky wasteland. It stretched its form, bringing matter into its graceful rhythm. Music—don't underestimate music, the melody is a simple yet effective rule—became the initial order, matter divided according to its rhythm, and the world is shaped with its beat. Deity transformed itself into a seed, its roots extending deep into the earth's core, growing continuously with the help of scorching lava. It absorbed and purified all the world's murkiness, finally growing into a towering tree. Just a metaphor to help you better understand the story.

[h3]The Era of Abundance[/h3]

The evolution of the world is like the four seasons in the forest. In spring, the giant tree blossomed with colorful flowers, and nectar dripped from the blooms, flowing into lakes, seas, and rivers; in summer, the flowers fell from the branches, turning into mud, forming mountains and valleys, grasslands, and forests. Autumn is the time of harvest, and the giant tree naturally bears abundant fruit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/26e505779b4e740d0d84038269599ed6c5971b91.png[/img]

In the first fruit, the Deity we know today was nurtured—the god unique to this world, the firstborn, now the God of Justice, The Rebuke. Of course, in that era, He held all authority, sweeping away all stubborn disorder. Then, He handed over the authority to other Deities.

In the second fruit, the three Deities controlling life and death were born—The Grow, The Silence, and The Dew. They bring the cycle of life and death to the world, with separation and reunion, laughter and tears.

The third fruit burst on the branch, The Rising and The Treacherous, twins of light and dark, their birth was also their farewell. The sun rises, the moon sets, light and shadow intertwine, time begins to flow with the alternation of day and night, and an unborn seed dissolves in its mother's embrace. The Unbeknown—the Deity of Fate and Time—has existed at every point in time since its birth. As an aside, the shell of the shattered seed returned to the stars, becoming the dim comet "Shadow Sun", constantly passing by the world, and will never to return its homeland.

The world tended towards completeness, order stabilized, and the creator The Sonorous was born from the fourth seed, the last seed to birth a Deity... or perhaps not, let me leave some suspense. From the subsequent seeds emerged the myriad spirits of the world: Elves, Mankinds, Orcs, Velvet Goblins, Spirits, and birds, beasts, snakes, lizards, fish, and insects. It was a long autumn, a golden era, where everything thrived in the land granted by the Deities.


[h3]Shadow Approaching[/h3]

Do you feel like something is missing from this story? Yes, since there are four seasons, where is winter? A visitor from the stars came from the sea of nothingness, streaked across the sky, pierced the majestic body of the giant tree, and bored into the boiling crust. Another primordial god—let's call it the "Outsider"—set its sights on our Eulogize. It was an equally long winter... the giant tree decayed, the creator's music slowed its tempo, the broken crust formed bottomless chasms, and the last seed nurtured by the giant tree fell into them, tightly grasped by the Outsider's tentacles. Of course, none of this was known to the beings on the ground, the giant tree used its last strength to cover the wound, and the creator's last sound before disappearing was a gentle lullaby, granting its children a final rest. The Outsider vanished into the mantle's depths, the golden era trembled for a moment, then resumed its song and dance.

[h3]Praise, the King of Kings[/h3]

The Deities called for the response of the primordial ones, the spirits grew joyfully in the land granted by the Deities, and it was Eulogize's golden era. From hunting groups to tribes, to city-states, and then to kingdoms; from gathering to hunting to conflict, and then to war. Mankinds—our race—emerged from the spirits, gradually taking the land granted by the Deities into their hands. The next name, you must not be very familiar with: Kurulek, the King of Kings. Every race has its legend of him, calling him by the same name. Some revere him as a savior, others denounce him as a tyrant, but all epics do not deny his power, glory, and courage. The king's Legion fought on all fronts, the king's scholars explored the ends of the earth, and the king turned the land granted by the Deities into the paradise of Mankinds, into the Kurulek Empire, or "Ancient Empire." Spirits, Orcs, Velvet Goblins, either avoided the flames of war or were subdued by the Legion's blades, all crossed the chasms, leaving the land granted by the Deities, and heading to the outer wilderness. The firstborn, the proud elves, relied on the power of Mana, occupying the northern plains, and standing against the empire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/7e36dc76ba6bc0d629325861f21bac6ba7365ce6.png[/img]

The greatest king would not allow dissenters to exist beside his throne. Mana must be used by the empire, if it cannot be sought from the top, then it must be explored below. The king's Scholar delved into the earth's scars, excavating the ancient crust, they heard a voice, speaking of the beauty of Mana, painting the sweetness of the future. The returning ones brought back the path to a brilliant future, and the king gladly agreed. All power must submit to the majesty of the throne.

The king's Scholar became the king's sorcerer, the power of Mana led the way for the king, crushing the proud elves' border barriers. Finally, the elves gave up resistance, they activated the ancient relics left by the creator, reshaping the entire northern continent into a floating island, fleeing in haste from the king's wrath. The king mourned the lost territory of Mankinds, but this insignificant loss was not worth a great effort to fill, for Mana had opened an inexhaustible treasure trove for Mankinds.

[h3]The Era of Collapse[/h3]

I said, "Everything has its price." Mana took Mankinds' golden era to an unimaginable peak, but this peak was built on a shaky foundation. The sorcerers—now they are The King's Servant, the king's advisors—already possessed power beyond mortal reach, but they wanted more. The Ancient Empire excavated the land and mountains beneath them, seeking to uncover more secrets buried beneath the rock layers. They did, they unearthed the world's greatest secret: the decayed roots of the giant tree resurfaced, along with flowing lava, twisted flesh, and an army spawned by hostile. Yes, Demonspawn and the forbidden Deity, The Seething, the last seed that fell into the rift, the last race, and the last Deity, twisted into the Outsider's slaves in the deep dark underground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/9e2c60236fe2af0bb8a5b90671af890398389d9e.png[/img]

The empire's guardians fought to the last moment. The king's Legion staged heroic struggles, swords and magicians could fight armies but could not dispel lava and Deity. The empire took centuries to build, but its destruction happened in a night. The land granted by the Deities was occupied by the Outsider's minions, the roots of the giant tree became Eulogize's sore, the golden era was overshadowed by the color of lava, and the era of war arrived with a roar.

[h3]The Era of War[/h3]

The surviving Legion covered the retreat of the survivors over the ridges into the barren wilderness of the Outer Circle, and those previously exiled races were forced to migrate again. The eastern Caucaid people moved to the vast lands further east, the southern Divinelander occupied the center of the Outer Circle, and King Kurulek and his court fought to the last, retreating from the western mountains to the endless desert. The dream of the golden era shattered with a crash, the bloody reality stood in the king's way. In the court, the king's advisors argued fiercely; some advised the king to settle, and others urged the king to embrace even stronger and uncontrollable power. Under the golden dome, the king issued a decree with a hoarse voice: he despised his own blindness, denounced his own foolishness, he bent his proud back, expressing apologies to his former opponents. His envoys traveled to every settlement on the continent, bringing requests instead of orders: King Kurulek pleaded with all races to put down Hostile and reclaim their former homeland together.

A bit strange, right? After all, the recipients of this letter were all races exiled from their ancestral land by the Ancient Empire, some perhaps just exiled again. But three years later, a mighty army gathered under Kurulek's royal tent, Mankinds, Elves, Orcs, and Velvet Goblins, all under one banner. Perhaps out of fear of mutual destruction, perhaps considering the Ancient Empire still had over a dozen Legions, perhaps for higher reasons—the disaster awakened the Deities. The firstborn The Rebuke, and the goddess Dew descended to the world, assisting King Kurulek in resisting the corrupted lastborn, The Seething.

Everything that happened after the army set foot on their homeland, the details of that war, left no trace in the history books, and the records in Demonspawn Aktur are not worth trusting. In short, an earth-shattering war played out on the former homeland, only four of the thirteen Legions remained, King Kurulek fell on the battlefield, the goddess Dew perished in the war, her divine position remains vacant to this day. Demonspawn was defeated, The Seething fell into eternal slumber, and the Outsider's claws retracted underground, but we forever lost the land granted by the Deities, it has been filled with unremovable lava and corruption. That festering land is now the Circle of Calamity.

[h3]Echoes of the Past[/h3]

The story of the mythological era ends here. Beyond this, the Ancient Empire fragmented, and each nation's history was written by itself. Again, this history is my own conjecture, not guaranteed to be true. As I said, everything has its price, the King of Kings paid with his painstakingly built empire, if, I say if, there could be another King Kurulek in the world... what price would he/she be willing to pay?

notes.title: From Developer—— What's Crown and adventure?
notes.notes:
We define this game as an "open-world strategy RPG". Players will become heroes on the continent of Eulogize, exploring a vast fantasy world, encountering various companions, forming elite Legions, expanding family influence, and creating their own kingdom.

[h3]World View [/h3]

Let's talk about the game's worldview first. The story takes place on the fantasy continent "Eulogize", where a catastrophe has led to rampant lava, causing ancient empires to crumble. The balance between chaos and order is broken, leading to new conflicts. 

The game features a seamless, large map combined with multiple nations and areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/54fbf3bd787e504cecdbbdd08dbad43635fb8d9a.jpg[/img]

Various civilizations reside here: Chen-Yuan, who inherits ancient Eastern traditions; Ccaucaid, who preserves medieval styles; Sasin, who embodies ancient Egyptian culture; and the mysterious Demonspawn. Mankind cooperates with Elves, Spirits, and Orcs to resist the invasion of Demonspawn.

[h3]Sandbox Exploration [/h3]

When a game is labeled "open-world," exploration gameplay is undoubtedly an essential element. There are lots of surprises in this world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/9e2c60236fe2af0bb8a5b90671af890398389d9e.png[/img]

During the adventure, you may discover hidden resources, bizarre stories, and mysterious dungeons. Those scattered strongholds await you to reveal their secrets. 

Additionally, NPCs in the game have their own behavior logic, forming alliances or conflicts autonomously on this land. Every choice you make will change the course of this world. 

[h3]Combat System [/h3]

War is a crucial factor affecting the story's direction. In terms of combat system design, the game adopts a classic top-down view, supporting up to 1500 units fighting on the same screen. Players can command teams, deploy tactics, and make real-time battlefield decisions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/e39d572d348cdbc9fc48f535af39075d680c1793.jpg[/img]

Also, we have designed multiple different soldier types, including Warrior, Spearman, Assassin, Cavalry, Marksman, Magician, War Machine, Ki, Prayer, Beast, and Titan. Each troop type has its specific attributes and battlefield roles, with distinct characteristics in damage, speed, and attack range. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/995d138cee9ec802f06ad3edee95784b5cba3cdd.jpg[/img]

The game offers two modes: automatic and manual combat. If you choose manual combat, small-scale battles usually last 2-3 minutes, while large-scale battles require 5-7 minutes. Of course, speed-up, pause, and automatic combat functions are also provided. 

As we discuss the battlefield, there is another important part — your comrades... 

[h3]Hero Recruitment [/h3]

On this continent, you are not fighting alone. We have over 50 recruitable characters recently. Heroes will automatically take action according to world changes, and their attitudes based on your choices. They may become your friends, partners, or enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/5fa0056a4eea72ff64f316eb9fdb7f22cac66981.jpg[/img]

Recruiting these heroes requires satisfying some conditions. You can find them through exploration, then complete their exclusive missions, or build relationships through gifts and sincerity, they will become your most reliable partners. Each hero has a specific growing path, you can freely choose different development routes for them on their talent tree. 

During this process, you will go from being alone to having companions, and your influence gradually grows... 

[h3]Empire Rising[/h3]

Let's talk about how to build your empire in this world!

Once you have your first city, you need to accumulate enough "Reputation" to expand your influence. The city construction system is not quite deep, but you still can experience the growth of a faction. By constructing and upgrading different constructions, you can enhance various attributes of the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/34dd0e536764fdf8c503518e90eb77b64587525c.jpg[/img]

In terms of internal affairs, you can allocate territories, implement reforms, control war decisions, and even expel other forces. The diplomacy system includes trade, negotiation, alliance, and other options, with relationships between forces ranging from Hostile to Friendly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/2c2bea3d23297c5f08b36efed6abc49fe73b4b5d.jpg[/img]

By the way, there are no "optimal solutions" in this world. You can choose the cultural type of your force, which will affect your technological development direction and available troop types. You can decide whether to expand rapidly or take a steady approach, whether to be a peacekeeper or an ambitious overlord. 

This is "Crown and Adventure", a game world offering diverse choices. Whether you enjoy war or exploration, you can find your interesting things in Crown and Adventure. 

Looking forward to witnessing your legendary story on this fantasy continent.

notes.title: CROWN AND ADVENTURE DEMO RELEASE, SET FOR STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.notes:
The open-world strategy RPG "Crown and Adventure" demo is available now! Feel free to experience our game and leave your feedback via our official channels.  "Crown and Adventure" is going to participate in the Steam February THE NEXT FEST, we are looking forward to meeting more new friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/b4ca5cca09715c9758a83e045f89d06d71d65375.png[/img]
"Crown and Adventure" is a single-player strategy RPG, combining open-world exploration, legion command, and faction management elements. We have developed the core gameplay system, and we hope to showcase our progress to players through the demo, hoping our game will be liked by everyone!

The game features a large battlefield system built on a side-scrolling top-down view, supporting up to 1500 units in a single battle. Players can command 10 unique troop types, including Warriors, Cavalry, Magicians, and War Machines. They can also control Hero Characters in real time, using skills and traits to influence the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/995d138cee9ec802f06ad3edee95784b5cba3cdd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/e39d572d348cdbc9fc48f535af39075d680c1793.jpg[/img]
The game's background is a continent named Eulogize, it has a seamless vast map with 17 distinct areas, forming a fantasy and excellent world. NPCs will automatically take action and conduct a dynamic evolution environment. Every player's decision will affect the future of civilizations and the world. The map has rich interactive options, including hidden resource points, side quests, and mysterious dungeons. Additionally, there are over 50 recruitable Characters, who can develop into intimates, lovers, and even spouses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/8750d4b7203627ee4c54ee897ee266dd1b97fa06.jpg[/img]
In the game, you can freely manage your faction, becoming a free ranger or a dominator, all depends on you. Players can occupy cities, adjust Taxes, and establish or battle with various factions, choosing to align with a faction or establish their own nation. In the future, we will update more different tech trees for cultures and nations, directly affecting recruitable soldier types and faction development directions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115405/34dd0e536764fdf8c503518e90eb77b64587525c.jpg[/img]
This demo content includes:
[list]
[*]The [Zhao-Yang] area of the [Chen-Yuan Empire], about 10 hours experiencing duration
[*]11 Character classes, with 7 unique recruitable Heroes
[*]The featured soldier types of [Chen-Yuan Empire], and full combat gameplay.
[/list]
The game will be released in 2025, [b][u]download the "Crown and Adventure" demo and wishlist now![/u][/b]
 You can also follow and subscribe to  "Crown and Adventure" social media and official channels for more updates, please stay tuned!
